simple.accordion-12: Three exact HR questions and bodies; default item-1; transparent closed borders, expanded border/shadow, down/up marker; 8px gaps.
simple.accordion-14: Three exact SaaS questions and bodies; default item-1; 6px gaps, 32px circular plus/X, muted expanded circle.

nestedState.outer: 15 and16 each retain3 fixed categories containing3 complete fixed questions. Multiple-open categories, default item-1. Exclusive value/defaultValue and onValueChange retain verified124 ownership/cancellation semantics.
nestedState.inner: faqProps is keyed by outer item-1/item-2/item-3. Each independently accepts exclusive value/defaultValue arrays of faq-1/faq-2/faq-3, onValueChange, disabled, ref and triggerProps. Default first FAQ per mounted category. Uncontrolled inner state is destroyed when its outer panel closes, so reopening restores its mount default. Explicit controlled FAQ values persist through parent remount. Releasing value while mounted retains the latest committed owner state.
nestedState.events: Inner click proposals have exact component id, categoryId, faqId, open, previousValue, event, stable button and cancel(). Inner activation never changes outer selection or calls outer onValueChange. Consumer trigger handlers, ancestors and proposal callbacks may cancel. Gesture epoch is captured before handlers; synchronous owner transitions, disable and unmount reject stale work.
nestedState.keyboard: Only outer buttons participate in Arrow/Home/End navigation with orientation/dir/loop. Inner collapsible triggers retain native Tab/Enter/Space behavior and do not acquire invented arrow navigation. Decorative markers hidden from accessibility tree; each trigger controls a stable unique labelled content container. Native buttons type=button; no FormData fields or automatic form-reset state changes.
nestedState.focus: When closing a category unmounts a focused inner control, return focus to its still-connected outer trigger only if focus was inside that panel and remains at the removed target/body. Preserve explicit outside focus and do not focus an unmounted outer component.

nestedDistinctiveness.accordion-15: Project Planning/Team Operations/Client Support; three original category icons, outer down/up; inner leading chevron with explicitly bound open rotation, nested open neutral background. Original intended rotation made explicit.
nestedDistinctiveness.accordion-16: Campaign Planning/Content Workflow/Performance Tracking; no category icons, outer rotating down marker; inner trailing down marker visible only while open, retaining closed spacing. Original open:true first question per group.
